text: Very nice breakfast establishment having healthy choices with customer groups having various taste. Really enjoyed the avocado toast and omelets

This is my go to spot in the Eastlake area for sushi. The owner is usually the behind the sushi bat making rolls. They have a huge variety of fresh rolls that are good for any veteran or newbie sushi eater. I eat here at least once a month and often drive an hour to eat here unless Im in the area for business.

I've heard so much about this place but never had a chance to make it to their OG spot in NYC. Was very happy to learn they've expanded operations and opened a place in South Philly! Going in I knew this place was gimmicky and that I'd likely be overpaying just for the brand. If you can get that thought of your head, I promise you'll enjoy your meal here. 

The wait staff here is very pleasant and got all our food out to us quicker than I would have anticipated. My buddy and I each ordered the signature burger, Le Big Matt, which comes with an order of amazing waffle fries. Honestly, I think my favorite part of the burger was the pretzel bun.. it had a great salty tang to it. The burger sauce is also stellar and the whole thing is juicy and greasy and so satisfying. I know... it's $19 for a burger and fries. But for a splurge meal, you can't go wrong with this. The angel pie was also delicious. The truffle sauce drizzled on top of a white mushroom pie makes it such a decadent experience. The only drawback with the pizza is that it's quite small: 6 slices of square pie, each about the size of my hand. 

If you've never experienced this place, I'd for sure recommend it as a one off... the quality of the food is legit. It can definitely burn a hole in your pocket so I will probably only return if coming with friends who have never heard of/experienced Emmy Squared.
the best salmon tbh honestly rlly good and good atmosphere i would visit here anytime it's one of my top restaurants atm

Small restaurant for Lebanese food attached to a hookah lounge & small Mediterranean grocery store. Do lots of take out. 

The place doesn't look like much, but they have amazing food for incredibly cheap prices. I came with two of my friends and we split the appetizer combo, and we all got chicken schwarma sandwiches. Lots of options so that you can customize your sandwich. Amazing fries as well.

Have a variety of traditional Lebanese fruit cocktails including fresh juices, smoothies, and parfaits.

I'm not quite sure what the people who run this place....what they think they have going on, here.  You're a restaurant in a beat up boop boop strip mall behind the Shop Rite in Drexel Hill.  Keep on pretending to be Le Bec Fin and you'll end up closed just like them, too.

Trying to make a reservation one time, they said they could "squeeze us in" so we rolled with it.  When we got there, you could hear a gnat fart that's how dead it was.  

We moved out of state (military family), and we try to come back whenever we are in town visiting because we like the food and it's my Mom and Dad's favorite spot.  Being that we are visiting for my Mom's birthday, we wanted to treat her.  Called to make a reservation as nothing is showing as available online.  Whoever answered the phone was a bit abrasive and told me what the preferred time is after he asked when we were looking to come in.  It's only 6 of us - we aren't a large party.  Made the reservation to secure the spot and after talking with the rest of my family - 6:00 would have been better, and more reasonable.  I asked my husband to call back and see if we could get the time switched.  A sweet girl answers the phone and my husband asks for a table for 6 at 6:00.  She said sure, then what must have been the same tugmunch who answered when I called the first time overhears and rudely yells 5:00 or 8:00 only!

They have tables open - this places always does.  I get COVID, I'm a RN...so believe me, I get it...no reason they could

This is our go-to place for delicious food and our favorite margarita with the tiny corona in it! Have had many fun and playful interactions with the staff that makes us want to return. They can get a little backed up during rushes but I think they're figuring out their kinks in the system

My favorite restaurant, hands down. From the margaritas to the cheese dip... its always so good. If you havent been there before. Do yourself a favor and go! The service can get a tad spotty when they are busy, but thats expected in a busy restaurant.  They still do a great job.  Though... Id probably still go if they made me wait on myself.  Its worth it.

I've been here a few times, every time amazing. The was a lady manager there that will always hold a great place in my heart; she was so down to earth and helped out greatly with me and my date (boyfriend now) when I got a flat tire. The food and service is amazing always recommend!
A solid sushi option. We did takeout and got a bunch on rolls to try. We liked the spicy salmon and mexican roll the best. This might sound weird, but I liked their sushi rice a lot.

This place is unique, charming, and has delicious coffee! They have selections for a bunch of different taste preferences, and the seating is nice to either work or chat with friends.

I got the honey cayenne latté... phew! it was something special: spicy and sweet and very adventurous.

I think this place has the best sushi burrito in St. Louis! The price is very reasonable the quality is so good.  They have a wide variety of options for sushi burritos and you can also make your own burrito as well. There are not many seatings so if you have a large group you can order food here and head over to Narwhals for drinks. I think it's the best combo ever and they are so close to each other.

I am on the beach every Saturday and have eaten at this restaurant 25 plus times.  I love the location and the food is pretty good.  What my friends and I have found frustrating, is the many times in the last year,  we have been turned away.  Just yesterday, at 11:30, a friend of mine walked up to order a sandwich and was told, "we are not taking food orders right now".   "We are not ready."  A month ago, at 12:10 (lunch time), I stood in line and then was told, "we are not taking food orders right now."  " We are too busy".  This is a common occurrence now when they're open and you never know when they'll be open.  They were closed on 2 Saturdays in January and there was about 75 people on the beach playing volleyball at lunchtime.  I just have to wonder if the owners know how much business they are losing.  It was never like this a year ago.

this is my favorite chicken fillet (inside joke)!!! please don't let this jinx me but from service, speed, courtesy to flavor they rarely ever let me down. even if i have had an issue they correct it with zero problem. i enjoy the employees i encounter on each shift. y'all i have received a hand written note that wished me a good day from this cfa placed on my bag like come on?! what other place is that freaking sweet?? 

this morning i decided i had time to stop and get breakfast but i wasn't sure if the drive thru would have a line so i did carry out. there was only one car in line when i pulled up  but i kept carry out. i placed the order as i was pulling in and it was ready when i hit the counter. they confirmed it was me with name. it took talking 2 minutes. food was correct and fresh.
Awesome atmosphere, service is great. Music was Good Friday, My only complaint is the band music Saturday night was a bit sleepy.
Scarlett was super friendly and delivered amazing customer service. I was completely satisfied with my meal and everyone else was welcoming from the moment i walked in. I'll definitely be back soon.
Chipotle or any other taco selling restaurant has NOTHING on Juan's! My vary first tome ordering; I fell completely head over hills for the quality of food. So tasty! I'm a Juan's chica ahora!

Excellent food and service. We Have been here several times and never had a bad meal. We've always had wonderful servers and the rodizio guys are phenomenal. Your meal never feels rushed and cocktails from the bar are always refreshing and well-made. The dress code ranges anywhere from business casual to casual although I believe their website stated business casual. The salad bar is vast with plenty of offerings, delicious sides are delivered to your table (fried bananas, cheese balls, mashed potatoes) and refilled as needed. Be sure not to fill up though because the meat is the main event. So many varieties of steak, chicken and even salmon. My personal favorites are the filet mignon and flank steak.
Simply flavorless. I gave them a 3 because the guy who answered the phone was super nice and suggested vegan options.

Deliciousness. Brisket hash is off the chain served in cast iron skillet,pancakes with pecans were on point. The best part was our server. Did not get her name. She was sugar. Young girl who stated she was vegan but was able to recommend carnivores dishes. Go people. It's fire.
Nom nom, good foods, good music and good vibes. If ya don't want these things in life just stay home.
I would have liked to review this restaurant, but for some reason it was not even a third full early on a Wednesday night and we were told we needed a reservation. Oh well.
Some of the best food in New Orleans!! The shrimp tortellini is delicious! The pecan praline pie is too!

Hands down favorite place in Madeira Beach. Grouper sandwich is what they claim - it's simply the best. No liquor served here but good selections of beers, wine eh. Food and service makes up for it. This is a casual bar / restaurant like more places in st Pete. I've never had anything less than an exceptional experience at this quaint little beach restaurant. The servers are friendly and hardworking. Literally no cons or complaints here!

This place has such a cute outdoor set up!! I really loved the atmosphere. There are many Covid precautions in place as well. 

We had reservations around 6:30 and were seated promptly. Our waitress was really nice and explained the precautions as well. We ordered the vegetable board as an appetizer and I have to say it was the best part of my night haha!! So delicious and great variety on the board. For my entree I ordered the Campanella pasta. I liked it but I did find it a little bland and dry. My fiancé ordered the jerk chicken which we both loved! So much flavor. 

My only complaint is our waitress got really busy and we had to wait almost 30 minutes for our check. But I totally understand it's difficult to keep track of everything all at once! I highly recommend this place if you're looking to do something fun this summer.

Everyone who works here is incredibly rude! From the waitress who acted annoyed with me for asking what time they stopped serving food to the bouncer that knocked on the table after I sat down and rudely said, 'get the F$&& up, this is their table'. I didn't know the table was reserved and thought the previous occupants had left when they got up and took their belongings. I didn't realize anyone would pay money to reserve a table in such a hole. He could have mentioned that to me a little nicer. I heard another server shouting at customers to keep it moving as they walked in the door and as I tried to get to the bar someone in an unmarked shirt was waving for me to keep walking. I didn't know they even worked there Bc his shirt wasn't labeled but the spot that looked like an open hole was actually the spot where the servers place orders at the bar. Very confusing, very rude staff, felt like I was in basic training again and wasn't doing anything right. Will never be coming back.

I believe this was the second or third time I ordered delivery from this store.  In the past, just ok, chain pizza, passable quality.  My latest experience was DREADFUL.  All meat pie, hardly any meat, cold, tasteless bland and soggy.  I asked for anchovies on the side, I received 4 anchovies wrapped in tin foil.  Not the best presentation.  The kicker was, these little fishies had not seen the ocean in 10 years. They were black, no kidding, black.  Straight to the garbage.
Essentially, no love, no pride in product.  Just a box full of mush for $20.00.
I've written enough, I will not even broach the topic of the guy who answers the phone.  Boarders on rude with zero personality, oops I did.  First contact a bad one.

Great pull to the bread, not overly salty, and the meat was super tender

Bravo..................................

Very solid dinner spot! Dinner in with a party of 6 people and started with the heirloom Barata. Some of our party had the butternut squash ravioli, pizza, chicken parm and spaghetti dish. Meals came out quick, hot and were delightful!  We look forward to our next visit

I picked up pizza and they got my order completely wrong. It was actually a gift not to myself and I found out a few days later ( the 2 young girls I gave it to were too embarrassed I tell me right away) that it was completely wrong. So I called the restaurant and instead of offering a pizza on their dime to make it right, they said they'd give me $3 measly dollars off of one.

I have frequented this place for many happy hours ans gave extremely generous tips. 
I will not give one more dime to them and why would I pay them more money to make it right. 

Terrible management as I have also worked in the restaurant industry for years. Extremely disappointed so were the little girls I bought for. What a shame.
Outstanding food and service.  Went there twice in one week.  Long waits but totally worth it. The biscuits are fabulous.

Had curb side delivery.  The waiter brought it out with a mask (much appreciated). Ordered the fig, goat cheese, and pork, and the Caesar salad. Both were out of this world. Best pizza I have had not just in Tucson but in many states. And the dressing on the salad - powerful but amazing. Will never order pizza from anywhere else again. Any negative reviews here are from Karens who are offended by lamb and anchovies in pizza and prefer a good ole Pizza Hut pie!
How can you get a raw pizza go to Jules and wait 20 minutes.No quality control and no satisfaction.This location needs to seriously review their procedures and get employees on board

GREAT LOCALLY OWNED COFFEE SHOP
The low fat breakfast sandwich is thick with whole grains and gooey cheese and egg white. Even better they make it in house. The coffee is French Truck so you know it is roasted fresh not even 5 miles away. 

The owner is that great combination of cheery genuineness and efficient barista.

What a great place off the beaten path I stopped for diner and drinks. I sat at the bar watching MNF enjoyed my Margarita and diner as I was eating I was paying attention to the Bartender Juan he was non stop running every direction serving everyone I was surprised how quick my diner was ready I enjoyed this place very much and I will definitely bring the guys up here working with me here to eat and thank you Juan awesome bartender.

The pizza is wonderful the Service is absolutely awful.  Worst ran place I've ever been. Ordered online and said it would be ready at 6:40.  Got there girl ask my name and comes back and says something went wrong they didn't have my order started but they were starting it now.  I stood inside until 7:20 then ask again for someone to check. The girl literally said "I don't know what they doin back there you should probably just get a refund" WHAT?!?!? So then I watched 20 people walk through the walk in line and get there food and finally a sweet girl said she was gonna make it herself and did.  Once she started making it it was about 6 min and I was out the door.  It would be a 1* but the Pizza is delicious just hope they hire some actual managers with intelligence and experience.  Shame to see such a good place go to waste being run so poorly.

Don't go. Waste of time.  I wanted to order breakfast, my wife wanted to order lunch, but in this wonderful establishment you can't do both, it's one or the other. Apparently you can't have breakfast and lunch on the same check. I asked if we could have separate checks, I was told no. I would have to sit at different table than her to do so. My wife ordered the guacamole chicken blt And I reluctantly decided to order the hot chicken. It took close to 50 minutes to receive our food. My wife's sandwich didn't have any guacamole on it and I received the worst excuse for fried chicken I have ever seen.  I wish I would've read the reviews before hand. It's was the worst meal I've ever had in an airport. When I asked for the check it took another 20 min to get to the table  and we had to ask 3 different servers for it. Then our server tells us that she doesn't have a copy of the receipt because the printer isn't working, but we can just pay her $25 for the food. I didn't do that, waited another few minutes for a paper receipt and left hungry and disappointed.
Delicious! Will be back and frequently! I got the Greek salad with a side of gyro meat.  My husband got the chicken shawarma. Both meals were so good.

We had the best waiter ever. It was date night so we went for it with Wagyu steaks. My wife had the filet topped with blue cheese and I had the ribeye rib cap. So unbelievably good. The side scallop was like butter after the steak. We had a crab cocktail and oysters to start. What a night!

after eating here so long i'm done. you can't even order a pizza at 8:09. last friday i tried at 845. i get the covid is hard but this apathetic way will doom your business. good for lunch only these days. bye

We love the food and the service is always great. Bobby is our go to server, he remembers what we want since we get the same thing every time. With hundreds of customers that is pretty amazing, thanks Bobby!!
Order the ricotta pancakes with lemon curd: it's the best!!!

Been super solid as far as the ingredient quality, the staff kindness, and despite the need for shorter spring break hours, I've managed to go in make a new fan out of my boyfriend he's visiting from the East Coast. He absolutely loved his custom selection this evening and mine was delicious as well.

I highly recommend the customization, I love it in wheat with pesto/sautéed spinach/ mushrooms /cucumber/red onion/artichoke hearts/a fried egg and avocado... 

The portion is really large and they use the pulled out inside of the bread bowl as well as the sliced off top to make super yummy garlic bread that saves well if you get too full and a need a snack later!

Love the later extended hours during the normal school year and really have been enjoying the strawberry basil change... Picnic style bench tables inside and out relax chill atmosphere with wall murals and a low-key vibe, 

I prefer takeout but if you need to get out of your apartment or are here on a vacation and it's right across from a park and you can even go over and have a little picnic by the water wheel and the pond...
Yum yum!!!
This place is definitely a go to..... The service and food was great! We had a great time. We ordered different plates and everything was phenomenal! My favorite was the lamb chops.

I went yesterday with a couple of co-workers for lunch.  We agreed that it was one of the best places we've been in a while.  It was the last chance to go eat anywhere before restaurants were shut down due to the corona virus, so we were lucky enough to enjoy the outdoor eating area located near La Cocina.  I got the tagliatelle with cacio + pepe for lunch, it was creamy and divine with a cheesy, peppery goodness, and came with a small piece of focaccia bread, I loved the little to-go container that it came in.  I got some bucatini and bolognese to take home for dinner as well.  Fresh daily made pasta, sauce, there is also coffee, and pastries!  They practiced social responsibility by only allowing 4 people in the store at a time, and bringing your food outside to you.  I took the extra time for lunch to get over here, and it was totally worth it!

We have eaten here in the past and it was pretty good but Lundi Gras was horrible. They were not prepared for the crowd they had at all!  Waited an hour for a table for four. Then only order quick items because the waitress told us the kitchen was behind. Order crawfish ettouffe  and spaghetti and meatballs and Ferdi poboy and a roast beef poboy. They brought out the ettouffe right away. (Worst ettouffe I have ever eaten. All you could taste was salt) after that we waited another hour an the waitress told a few more minutes. Another 30 min go by and she walks by and said that the kitchen would be STARTING on our ticket soon!  We paid for what we had gotten and left. No apology or anything from management. We walked right by him and he didn't say a word. New owners are in no way as good as the original owners.

Wonderful Ybor City Addition! Noticed the open signs today as I was driving by the Port area not far from Ikea in Ybor City. I had a very delicious empanada with a recommended coffee special.  It was all wonderful! The space is large and comfortable. Great place to open up your lap top and get caught up on emails. I loved the pictures of Tampa's Coffee Factory history on the walls. You will get a great taste for Ybor City history with coffee and food options!  Did I mention the Dominoes tables?

A group of retired military and their wives made a reservation at the 4th St Glory Days. The manager Bill made sure we were taken care of with all the COVID restrictions. We had 2 tables of 4 each and were able to social distance with no problems. The servers were all masked as were we when we entered the restaurant until our drinks arrived. The staff made us feel safe and that is a good feeling during these times. Also, the food and service was exceptional. Its a great sports bar even though no real sports going on (ok we got to watch our golf). Kudos to Bill and his staff for taking care of veterans in these trying times.

Tried for first time after storm kinda blocked my route to McCaffreys/Altamontes ( based on Yelp reviews... thanks!)
Chicken piccata and chik cheesesteak/ peppers/ spinach calzone; both were excellent. Order ready  on time from online, owner very friendly.
Why 5 stars?
Piccata: Chicken very tender, nicely balanced wine/ lemon sauce ( no capers but good salt from sauce), and... best if all: al dente pasta, despite taking out stop to watch a Neshaminy Creek flooding.
Calzone: light crust, juicy fillings, good ratio of chicken, cheese and peppers/ spinach. Excellent.
Impressive first visit, and I'm fairly demanding. Excellent food worthy of higher-end restaurant, friendly service, hot/ on time, priced reasonably. I'll be back. Thanks guys.

I have to say that this place is not very customer-friendly. First, I ask for a combination of flavors in my small wing order (I'm told you can choose up to 2 flavors) and when I specify the assortment I'd like, I'm told that "the kitchen will do what it wants".  I then pay, and am told that my very minimal to-go order will take 15-20 minutes. This is everything you DON'T want when you're stopping in for an easy take-home dinner.

Casual counter-service spot for tons of different creative varieties of chicken wings. Also serve beer and have a couple options for sides

The space is very low-key and was mostly filled with teenagers post-sports practice when I was there, and there are TV's playing sports in very convenient places. There are a few low and hightop tables with paper towel rolls on each, a nice touch to counteract the messiness of the wings. The wings are served in styrofoam boxes. 

The employees were very friendly as well. 

I went with the flavor of the month, Korean BBQ, with a side of fries. The fries were generic, but they had a great spice on them. The wings were pretty tasty as well
punk motherfuckers you bastards served me a sandwich combo with a hair in it  it's coo though y'all gonna catch covid-19

We had high expectations, but were sadly disappointed.  The  Cheesesteak, Italin pork and bufflo chicken were bland, the meat was not tender and the entire sandwhich lacked flavor.  The meat was frozen, onion rings and french fries were generic frozen food.  Nothing special or fresh served here.  Service was friendly, but the order was not made correctly.  Paid $1.00 for cheese for the fries and the cup was tiny and not enough for a large order of fries.  Paid for extra cheese on all the sandwhiches and ther was a noticeble  lack of cheese.  Everything that makes  a cheesesteak delicious was missing.  The onions were chopped tiny and not full strings, which are better for grilled onions.  For the price point, the food was not worht it.  Would not recommend this place even if you are in the neighborhood.  We are giving it 2 stars because the staff was polite.

My husband and I love greek food and have been wanting to try more spots around the city. Most Greek restaurants are kind of dumpy but what I love about Canal Bistro is how it feels so intimate. The host sat us in a quiet corner of the restaurant where no one else was. It felt so private and the food tasted so authentic! This might be our new go-to spot!

I had heard the stories, the tale of Pizzava, the best pizza to touch Reno, NV, hailing from Portland, OR. We were so lucky to have them grace our presence and taste buds.... and what a letdown.

There was absolutely nothing special about this pizza. Got a double pepperoni and an egg and steak and it's just... okay. The easiest way to summarize my thoughts on it is, it's Dominos flavor profile with better ingredients. Thank you, next.

So, post COVID-19 lockdown Luncheon with the family, and it was a real welcome change.  This establishment took all the precautions, kept things humorous, and we were feeling at home in no time.  Food was very tastey, temperatures were perfect, and timing was just long enough to allow us to settle into our chairs and relax. Tyler Anne was who attended to us, and she was a fantastic server.  Professional, and hilarious! We can't recommend this place enough!  OMG Shrimp & Gouda Grits...!!!!! We will be back.
Fern was an awesome server, bartender, cook, and superwoman. Food was delicious! We really loved her.
This is my one of my favorite restaurants. I have never had anything I didn't like and I have tried just about everything on their menu with the exception of their breakfast items.
The service, atmosphere and food are all amazing. The staff is very knowledgeable about the menu items making it easy to make decisions as a vegan.
Went here spur of the moment and was delighted with the meal. Portions were generous. We had gyros and Italian Beef and will be returning soon. Customer service was good as well!

I came to Sea Dog with some friends for a Saturday brunch. This place hit the spot! We got there around 11:30am and it was mostly empty. We got to park right up front and go upstairs to the dining room. It was a beautiful day so we sat out on the balcony to see the boats and water. Our server was incredibly kind and welcoming. We found out she just had oral surgery and was still so much fun so kudos! We ordered our drinks and I got a mimosa. It was large and refreshing. My friend ordered their version of the lager beer and asked to sample the house cherry soda (I believe) and mixed it together and it was good so I'm pretty sure she just created a new specialty drink! This wasn't really a breakfast brunch place and so I ordered the burger with gluten free bun and asked for an egg on top! They accommodated me and it was only two dollars more. I loved this place and it's location. A great spot for drinks, dinner, and to bring the dogs!

Perfect lunch spot. Tables turnover quickly enough usually seated in 5 mins. It's small so it can get crowded and I order my foods to go frequently. If you like spice, the spicy hummus and hot peppers are great! Also love the falafel!!
Food here was good but service was really really bad. Waitress disappeared forever. Never saw her again

Not really sure what this place is a combination of a waffle bar/yoga studio/I just don't know. Upon walking and I noticed how dirty the place was the floors were so disgusting looking and it looked like a school cafeteria. 
Didn't last more than two minutes in this establishment and I'm sure the food prepped is unsanitary just by the looks of it. I know that there's a built-in yoga bar/keto studio but the signage is all over the place it's like 50 places in one. Not sure what kind of an audience you're trying to attract or you're just trying to cater to the built-in members of the studios but this is no Revell Kitchen. 

I just can't with this place lol

Fast casual spot serving quality ingredients. They did not skimp on portions and it was a good price! I got the eye round steak and brisket pho and my boyfriend got the sesame beef vermicelli. Both were really good!

The MOST beautiful setting for special occasions to be found in the Midwest. The menu is larger than in the original location in Broad Ripple. A bar has been added to the line up also. The cosmopolitan is perfect. The quiche is memorable. The Neopolitan cake is wonderful especially the strawberry layer which is sublime.

We went here on a Tuesday afternoon after doing laundry. We were in the middle of a PCS and were sick of travel food. We gave it a try and it was amazing. We ordered 2 jerk chicken with cabbage and 2 barbecue chicken with salad for our 5 member family. Even our 8yo picky eater couldn't get enough of the rice and beans. Even the lemonade was exceptional. I will have to go again to see if I experience what others are saying but as of now I love it!
Good food and good service. Nice place that I have stopped by a couple of times. Sunday brunch is nice with Eggs Benedict and omelettes offered. Lots of TVs to watch sports.

Our first stop on our trip to SB. They have a really nice outdoor seating area. 

Love their menu options, which caters to meat lovers, vegetarians, and vegans. 

T had the combo of 3 empanadas and chimi papas. They are very generous with the chimi papas, which were delicious. Of the carne, serrano, and hongos, T's favorite was hongos. 

I had the humita, hakuna batata, and quinoa. My fav was definitely humita. In the quinoa, the goat cheese was all loaded on one side, so I didn't really get a taste of it until I'd eaten half. Hakuna batata is on the sweeter side due to the sweet potato. 

If I were local, I could definitely see myself becoming a regular or ordering to take home and bake on my own.

The food was fine. I ordered delivery. I specifically flagged that there was a detour to the house. I got a call, from who I believe to be the owner as well as the delivery person, and he began the conversation by just yelling at me for their being a detour. I pointed out that I included directions in the original order. He yelled at me again again saying he didn't game those. When I started telling him the directions he yelled at me a third time. He suggested I go meet him at a nearby plaza. I said no (kind of not the point of ordering the delivery) and he finally let me give him directions. He did correct his attitude the second and third time he called me because he was unable to follow simple detour signs and apparently didn't have any sort of GPS or map. Once he got here he informed me that I was out of the delivery area and the website was wrong... So apparently he was doing me this one great favor but never again. If he is the owner it's amazing he sees himself as being great at hospitality, as listed in his Bio here. The food is definitely not worth the hassle.

You know you've got a great vegetarian/vegan restaurant when your customers have no idea they're not eating meat. I came to Yelp to rave about the super friendly service and yummy Al Pastor and surprise! Great job, Guys. Delicious and we really appreciated the warm welcome and hospitality.

Go someplace else that actually has a staff that can manage their jobs. 
They gave me a COMPLETELY prepared hamburger.....with NO MEAT OR CHEESE. There were literally 2 other people in the drive-thru line....and with the Quarantine? NO ONE in the restaurant. How can you make a mistake THAT NOTICEABLE? More importantly...what happened to my patty???

When I went there to replace it, they did not seem to believe me that they made that big of a mistake. I offered to show them a picture of the burger, as well as the burger itself, but they declined to see it. They just wanted me gone, it seems. The burger they gave me? Had so much salt on the meat patty, it was almost inedible. SAD. 

Da fuq, guys? 

You want a burger with NO meat and cheese? Go here! You want an inedible replacement burger with a side of idgaf? Go here....

Management....you need to make sure your employees are not so high, they are forgetting how to make a basic burger! 

You have good fries....but NOT good enough to bring me back.
Great place!   Friendly staff!! Love the smoothies!! Sweet potato fries are awesome too!!
Love Samaria Cafe! Hands down our favorite breakfast place. The quiche is amazing and for a traditional breakfast you can't beat it. Friendly staff too!

I order a lot of pizza and I am a huge fan of New York pizza specifically, but I found this pizza to be very bland. The sauce had no flavor, there really wasn't much sauce at all. It was not crispy at all and could've used another minute or two in the oven. I had to add salt and garlic powder just to make it edible. I don't mean to be rude but I did not like this pizza
Cute little place- they have Kalesia tea which is my favorite! Egg biscuit was more than I was anticipating but very good- definitely will return :)

Ordered. Devoured. Left happy.
Simple as this: Order. Eat. Leave happy.
I ordered the Californian burrito. What made this special was the french fries inside the burrito. Typically, when I've ordered this burrito at other places, I would always have to request french fries inside. This place gets it right! no need to ask for the french fries in the burrito because they already included in their Californian style burrito. So good!

Portion size of the burrito is a bit big. I imagine two people could split one if you wanted to. I would have split this without a doubt, but was hungry after a long day walking in the sun. Even people walking by commented on how large the burrito was. What can I say? These hips don't lie! I know good food when I see it. 

Friendly staff that had a  welcoming manner. Always  a pleasure to do business with these kind of restaurants. Friendly smile goes a long way.

I have been meaning to come try this place for months! 
So glad I finally got time! 

I went during the day, there were tons of seating options and the restaurant was light and open. The second we opened the door we were overwhelmed with delicious smells! It was mouth watering. 

I would recommend ordering several small plates and sharing. I ordered the Poke, Brussel sprouts, and fire cracker chicken. A delicious mix of flavors. 

The bartender was welcoming and friendly. He also makes a mean hot toddy! 

I will definitely be back and am looking forward to the summer months and being able to sit on the patio.

The restaurant is located in Midtown, above Piñon and pie face pizza. We biked because parking can sometimes be tricky. There are bike racks out front next to the stairs leading up to Arario.

The Big Catch is a complete up grade from the place that was there before the Big Catch.

Let start with what I love about The Big Catch, first of all the name.lol I use to go to the Big Catch when it was dt like 25 years ago. Secondly the great vibe which includes the music,the latest cation and the great decor...picnic tables have been painted by local artists and they are soooo cool!  Lastly, the staff is amazing, friendly efficient and busting their butt. 

So I'm not a huge fan of the food. Now I've tried a few things and some are good and some are not so great. My first trip I have the burger and my friend had the shrimp boil. I decided to get asparagus with my burger, I was surprised there were only like 7 skinny spears . The burger was good but nothing extraordinary. I tasted the shrimp in tbe shrimp boil and they were good Also the sausage was good  but the potatoes weren't cooked. So overall the meal was ok. My next meal there was a couple days later and this time I ordered the cauliflower , my friends had the grouper bites . For entrees we had the shrimp boil and the rib on plantains. 

Everyone enjoyed the Cauliflower, it was flavorful with a bit of sweetness. They shrimp boil was good, everything was cooked properly this time. As for the Grouper bites , my friends weren't impressed, I guess they didn't have much flavor. As for my entree, I had the Jerk rubbed short rib with a rum reduction over plantains served with a side of roasted carrots. The rib itself was t
Went to meet noodles because everyone has been raving about it! Lives up to the hype! Fantastic!

I had the worst dining experience every. The owner is rude. When I confronted him about my order being incorrect he insulted me by calling me "Fat Boy." No way to treat a paying customer. Needless to say, I will not being doing business with this establishment again. I would suggest doing business with a restaurant that appreciates their clientele.
Excellent .....very well crafted.....whoever is making this bbq knows what they are doing.

First of the atmosphere is awesome! It's hard to stand out in the sea of restaurants in Santa Barbara But this one does it. The cuisine is delicious and I Love the outdoor area to dine. This place is so quaint but so beautiful!

As seen in Sharktank many years ago. Had to try this place since we are visiting Nashville. Ordered the grilled cheese donut and it was good - but not super wowed that would want me to to order a second one. The grilled cheese and creamy tomato soup are all good.

Not a bad spot if you really want some bar style food. Its not amazing, its not healthy, but its pretty satisfying and their covid response has been consistent. Definitely try the sb location over ventura which was awful
I can't believe they would allow the cook to NOT WEAR A MASK DURING A PANDEMIC. After seeing that, we decided to leave. This place clearly does not have your health in mind - DO NOT EAT HERE.

This place really went down hill, I was a frequent customers a couple of years ago when it was very nice and today I decided to take my family here to eat  ( never again) when we first entered the restaurant I noticed the floors were a mess needed to be swept and mopped.  I was told we had an hour wait which was fine because it was busy.  That turned into 1 hour in a half and while waiting it's easy to observe the staff wasn't professional they were very confused when it came to seating customers the manager wasn't any better he looked hung over or drink (that was his appearance)  once being seated we ordered and then decided to cancel the order and leave because the restaurant was just in pure disaster mode.
This place is amazing!!! Random stop from using yelp and was not disappointed at all! Burgers were delicious! Owner is super nice!!

Very OK breakfast joint. Our waitress was nice but failed to pay attention to small details. Told her I wanted fried eggs and they came out scrambled, my boyfriends eggs were supposed to be over easy and they came out fried hard (which was very apparent even without cutting into the egg). The espresso drinks are very sugary, probably going to get the French press if we return. Got the country shrimp skillet, the shrimp was very low quality, wasn't properly cleaned and WAY over cooked. Neither of us liked it, but we got it so we didn't waste it. Avocado toast was good and the cinnamon roll pancake was okay. Over all an ok experience. Unsure if I'll return.

Sunday 8/25-A perfect cafe for anything you want. It seems as if someone picked it out of France and dropped it into this quaint area in Wilmington. It is on a corner in a residential area in what I think is a perfect spot.

I attended early on a Sunday morning around 8:45. I was the first to arrive and it was my first time there so I had lots of questions. They made me feel very comfortable and you can sit wherever you'd like. I was served by a new server who was very polite. There aren't dedicated servers for each customer. They all work together and are all in to make your experience enjoyable. That's a great feeling because someone is always there to help you.

They have a full display of artists and pastries. As soon as you walk in there's a right display of about 5 to 7 different types of croissants. My additional review will recap some of them but for now I'm only talking about my breakfast.

I had an omelette with sausage, cheddar, arugula, and caramelized onions. FYI: all of the omelettes you must build yourself. It was delicious and filling. The omelette was cooked to perfection. Everything was seasoned well, the omelette size was perfect, and I tasted a new filling every time I bit into it. The potato portion size seemed small but it was perfect. I didn't want anything else after I was finished eating. This is my kind of serving size.

I finished my meal off with a raspberry club soda. Refreshing! This is one of my rare five stars but it was excellent. I want to go

Really enjoyed this coffee place! Even though there are a litany of options, I decided to go with a light roast coffee with caramel flavoring - I added a bit of cream and a packet of sugar and it was perfect. My friend ordered a turtle mocha - said she loved it but it's very sweet. 
The atmosphere is really warm and inviting with friendly staff to boot! I'm looking forward to coming in and trying more drinks, as well as some of their food options!
We were in for two hours on a Thursday afternoon and the place was packed the entire time! The back seating area seems ideal for getting work done if that's what you're looking for. Otherwise, it's a great stop for socializing and good coffee!
Asked for 10 piece TRADITIONAL Buffalo style wings. I got 10 wings, no sauce, no ranch or blue cheese dressing.....Sad.

Recommended by a family member. I love pizza and this was seriously the most delicious, flavorful cheese pizza I have ever eaten! It's kind of odd in a bar like place however it was worth the gamble! I would recommend to anyone who loves a good pizza!

Pretty bad experience. Came here Labor Day weekend and this was about the only place open on the French quarter. We waited 30+ minutes for a table. Service was slow, they seemed to not have enough staff. There was only 4 options for food: fried shrimp, hamburger, alligator or French fries. We've heard legends about the hurricane but I couldn't even drink more than a few sips. It didn't taste good. $60 plus tip for mediocre food, drinks and service. Would not return.
Didn't refill my water. Ordered a pasta dish and asked for a different sauce but they didn't add any of the veggies mention in the description. Pasta was very fresh though

No extra large pizza should EVER be 30 bucks. That being said, Woodstocks does make me less reluctant than usual to part with my money. The pizza is good, and they fold in their crusts at the edge. Sometimes, I dream about their barbeque chicken pizza. Mnn. One thing to note though is that the wait time is absolutely *atrocious.* Me and my friend ended up waiting over an hour for a pizza and some wings on a night where the place wasn't busy at all. Good pizza? Yes. High prices and long waits? Also yes. Not a good place to grab'n go if you're looking for a quick bite.

Tip: find a table before you find food. 
Quite a bit of fun downtown with a ton of people. A variety of food places. Very quirky. Reminds me of the main market in Saigon
Not worth the money. The food was subpar. The key lime pie lacked any lime flavor or tang. It was also very gritty. It was so bad to the point I question if it was made correctly.

Last week we went to the Carrabba's in Murfreesboro which was a horrible experience  we love Carrabba's and couldn't give up on it. So we decided to drive to Greenhills and wow EXCELLENT service from all! The manager has this location down right, Jordan was so sweet and very helpful with explaining different food items and drinks. Thank you so much for the great service. Welcome to Tennessee Jordan.
The oxtail is amazing. Had it for the first time in my life here. I dont know what took me so long. So close to me too. Everything is incredibly delicious. I suggest the Taste of Jamaica.

Came here one more time on a sunday afternoon. Apparently they dont do slices on the weekend, which was a huge disappointment since that was all I wanted. I was with a friend that doesnt like deep dish so we split a thin crust pizza. I didnt like it and it was so over priced! $3/ topping seemed excessive, especially when they barely put any on. Items like peppers, onions, olives...those should be like $1-$1.50 each especially on a small pizza. I ordered a drink. I should know by now not to order off their drink menu. the drink was gross. We only came here because my friend wanted pizza and the other place we tried to go to first was closed. I figured this would be a good second choice to just grab a slice. I dont know what the thinking behind no slices on weekends is but it seems like a bad decision. Not a fan of this place.

Yep its us again! Mi Amor has been stalking this place and finally got the entire family there and it did NOT disappoint! The girls ordered milkshakes (strawberry, curious (caramel apple right now yum!), and non dairy). All three of them said they were amazing! I took sips of all of them and equally agree, although the texture of the non dairy is not as creamy (go figure lol) but I did not find myself missing the "milk" of the milkshake.

Mi Amor and I both had smash burgers (me a single, him a double) with our favorite toppings. My burger was HUGE probably because of all my toppings but it was delicious! The fries are some of the BEST fries I've ever had! They're shoestring style and were nice and crisp! For a drink we both had making herstory's. I don't know if I would order it again, but it wasn't terrible. Plus its on a draft which I think it part of my hesitation.

My family loved it and we will definitely go again. It's SUPER family friendly and the staff is very helpful and friendly.

I have been ordering from this place for years and had always planned to.....until today.
I placed a simple order consisting of FOUR items including two duck entrees and two different burgers being today is a Saturday. Food arrives 90 MINUTES later only for my family and me to see that I paid $24 for 1/4 of two of the duck entrees. Next, the burgers are completely bare. No tomato, onion, or sauce. It's funny because I remember ordering two very distinct burgers only to end up with two things I did not order. Frustrated and through, I called and demanded my money back. A pleasant Saturday evening dinner with my parents RUINED.  -   (Thanks - Goodbye forever).

Ordered at 7:29 its now 8:05 just getting our food. Shredded chicken on our nachos were cold. Took them 10 more minutes to get our food back and no "I'm sorry" nothing. And still chicken was cold. Frozen margaritas tasted like they were watered down. I am not a complainer but when they mess up your order plus forget to send the ticket back someone should have came out and tried to fix the situation.

Great atmosphere and super cute and trendy spot! Food was good very different style and tastes. Great place to grab a drink or app with friends. A little pricey. Dogs aloud outside. Something cute is that everything on the menu starts with the letter C for the C House!

We come here often and love their Seabass, teriyaki salmon, breakfasts, salads, and Beignets!  Today the shrimp bisque was to die for... But in the past it was bland, so it may be irregular chefs.  The music is always good as well but it doesn't start until 7pm

I needed to get a Philly Steak and Cheese and Tomato Pie before I left the area-and this place had great reviews so I didn't hesitate to check it out.

We sat down and the waitress promptly brought out some hot and fresh complimentary rolls with an olive oil dip-this was actually very good.

We ordered a regular Nicks Favorite (sharp provolone, broccoli rabe and steak sub) and a small tomato pie.

When the sub came out, the meat was a little dry, but the sharp provolone and broccoli rabe together was good.

Now the tomato pie on the other hand... it was incredibly fresh tasting and the combo they made was just overwhelming and delicious. I will definitely be back for more-and it's very reasonably priced.

Overall, for a place with an extremely extensive menu, I wasn't expecting the quality I received, so-Bravo!

Not bad. Some issues, but not too bad ll things considered.

Good: 
+Nice looking place. 
+Well appointed with a courtyard.
+The bartender on Easter evening was fun to watch and seemed really intent on making the drinks as perfect as possible while still hustling.
+The 1 dollar Miller Pony's was great for my friend who still drinks.
+A bottle of water is served with every table as soon as you come in. That was perfect for me.
+ The calamari, a bit expensive for the size, was really wall done and the flavors were spot-on.The spinach didn't overwhelm the flavors and the tiny chopped pickled peppers were a great accent.  I'd give it a 4/5

The Bad:
-I didn't know who to tip. We had no less than 4 people come to our table (sometimes with really long waits between). 2-3 for service
-The Wagyu beef sandwich. Bread was DRENCHED in butter. Which may sound great, but it was dripping so much that it was hard to eat. And if that was wagyu, it must have been the one bad cut from the entire batch because even cut thin, there were gristly bits and it was NOT tender. There were also no mushrooms like it said on the menu and the only bit I tasted with horseradish was the GIANT glob in one spot and no others. It gave us both heartburn from how soaked it was. I ended up eating my half with no bread. 2/5 for the "wagyu".


The OK:
*Whipped Lardo spread-Now I'm biased because I've had this in Italy and in some 5 star restaurants. It didn't have the herby undernotes (like rosemary) that the usual

My favorite place in the universe! I love everything about this place. I've been going there since I was a tiny child with family for dinner. Now I take friends. And we make a night of it. Drinks at the bar, then go sit for dinner, meet a few new people, and then we have a few more drinks at either bar and then stumble home. I hope I can come here for the rest of my life.

The pictures on the Two Boots website led me think think, Looks good, although I have never heard any locals talk about it, I went for it anyway.  Result.... Mistake. 

My kids spread ragu sauce on toast then put cheese on it then retoasted it, while it was dry and had little flavor, I ate it and feigned my appreciation.  Unfortunately, my experience with Two Boots was worse. Plainly stated, Two Boots has the worst pizza in America. Drunks on Broadway may see no problem with their product, but I urge all reading this stay away.
Great live music from the  St. Louis Slim Trio and the best waitress Emily!!!!!! Emily you are NOT mean!

Horrible service! So to the area manager...hope you read this! I have been coming to the Lutz/54 store for over a year now, not good service, they make lots of mistakes, give you the wrong coffee etc but never have I experienced what looked like the store manager encouraging her employees to curse at and make fun of clients, this is completely unacceptable. To the franchisee, your store will suffer a lot from this, this is major, I would pay more attention to the quality of people you hire. The date was march/12/20 at 10:20 am,  drive thru, that might help you identify who it was.

Frenchy's is the BESTTT place to grab a drink and eat on Clearwater Beach! Way better food AND service than Palm Pavilion (which is across the street). Frenchy's is definitely a must when you visit Clearwater Beach!

(8-25-2020) We decided to take advantage of BOGO wings in one of our few restaurant trips in months. it wasn't particularly busy, there were several large family groups taking up seating and ample wait staff. We waited quite a while to get waited on, when our food finally came, we couldn't get her attention to get dinnerware or napkins or a plate for the basket of wings. Two male staff walked past us without asking if we needed help. Children were running around and playing near our table, guests didn't wear masks passing tables to go to the restroom. Honestly we felt that we were just on our own to go ask for assistance. Might do carry out, won't return.

We ordered a create your own pizza. Honestly, I think this is the best pizza I've ever had. We tried the garlic and herb butter sauce on it, with bacon, pepperoni, Italian sausage and Gyro meat. It was absolutely divine . My husband and daughter enjoyed it too. Would definitely order from here again.
Loved the food and great service!  Going back again tomorrow for a second go around!  Highly recommend as one of the best restaurants on historic Main Street!

They were a few things I needed for a South Indian recipe that I wanted to make. Since curry leaves are very hard to find in Tampa Bay, I decided to go here. 

This is a good-sized Indian/Mediterranean supermarket with all of the necessary spices you can think of for any related recipes/cuisine. It's located off of Fowler ave. in the Temple Terrace neighborhood.

They have a wide assortment of dried spices, snacks, produce, refrigerated, and frozen foods. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find fish tamarind a.k.a. Kodampuli or malabar tamarind for my Kerala fish recipe.  However, I did find everything else to complete what I needed close enough. They also sell kitchen ware. Finally found a new roti dawa here!  

They have an Indian style cafe if your hungry on the shopping trip there. Glad I looked this place up.

I've been here twice and had great experiences each time. We had the home made chips and onion dip to start and it was delicious, and then we had their giant pretzel, and then if you love ginger beer I would recommend their house made ginger beer it's awesome!
Their hamburgers are thick and great texture,  their pizzas are Chicago style but they arent afraid adding some Italian American pizazz! (Ie adding marinara ) i can't wait to go back

Tonight I watched the bakery girl touch all of the fresh bagels with her bare hands (no gloves) as she re arranged them. I'm already not a fan of this publix but it is the closest to my house. The deli guy always roles his eyes at us and never smiles or looks remotely happy to help anyone. 
I was pleasantly surprised by the guy in the meat section the other day stepping in to help as the seafood section was short staffed and he was happy to help and genuine about it unlike most of the other employees at this location. They can definitely benefit from a hospitality training store wide.

The restaurant wasn't every busy which made sense for a rainy Wednesday evening.   The waiter was friendly but needed to be asked to fill the bread basket as well as our water glasses.   

First disappointment was they had ran out of mint so no fresh berry mojito.   Our first appetizer was one of the cooked oysters which was tasty but the bacon over shadowed the oyster instead of enhancing it.  The grilled octopus had a good flavor but the white beans were bland and not needed.   

I had a difficult time deciding what I wanted for my main course so I got the ultimate mixed grill thinking I would get a nice tasting of different choices.   I was not impressed with the crab cake.   The grilled shrimp and salmon were nicely cooked and seasoned.  The mash potatoes lacked flavor.  My co-diners however expressed fully enjoying there meals.  I did have a bite of sea bass which was light flakey and delicious.   

For dessert the peach puff was pleasant but lacked something.   The chocolate silk pie was wonderful but did not have nearly enough raspberry sauce.

The decor within the restaurant was nice but the ladies room looked more industrial and sterile not what I expected for a fine dinning establishment.

I've now been twice to Happy Cactus for lunch and love this comfortable, tidy little cafe. Excellent food and service. Friendly staff. I'm most of the way through the taco menu -- two of those and a few of the house's homemade chips and salsa(s) make a perfect midday meal. (Plus, some of the freshest iced tea I've had in the area.) My husband and I will keep coming back!

Highly recommend trying this modern style coffee shop and bakery. They make there own sourdough bread which is used in both of the toasts pictured. The bread has a wonderful crunch on the outside and fluffy center. The espresso is smooth and delicious. Staff are incredibly nice! Everything I've had from their pastry counter has been delicious!

BURNED CRUST- first visit to highly recommended restaurant. Ordered LG Di Lusso w/onion, mushrooms, salad. OBVIOUS Pizza over cooked/burned. Crust-black on back and top. Chef boxed up burned pizza for us to Take Out. Took home...to put in trash.

I might use this location as a case study in determining how many times a franchise can get away with making the same mistakes over and over again. They've gotten my mobile order wrong the past five or so times I've been here, and somewhat regularly prior to that. I'm not a picky customer but either entire components of my meal were missing or they added ingredients I didn't ask for. It's not terribly difficult to read a bulleted list and add the items listed on it to a bowl but somehow the workforce at Smyrna Chipotle manages to fumble the task with impressive consistency. The only reason I keep coming here is because it's a guaranteed free meal when I complain to corporate about my incorrect mobile orders.

I go here all the time whenever I'm craving for some Indian food,never disappoint! The servers are very nice there. I usually get the same things whenever I go which are chicken samosas, Saag, Alo Goobi (highly recommend!), chicken lollipop, and chicken tikka masala. I usually eat my curry with an order of garlic naan and plain naan. I think I should explore different options next time, considering everything I've tried from them have been very delicious.

As my boyfriend is a vegetarian, we try to frequent restaurants that provide plentiful options for him. This place is completely vegan. Options galore!!!!

You order cafeteria style. As I said, LOTS of options...very hard to choose. But, they allow you to sample things. And, you can do half orders of their sides...so go crazy!!

First time I came I ordered the "crab"less cakes with remoulade slaw.  It was okay. I also ordered a side of mashed sweet potatoes and sesame kale.  That sesame kale is hella good. My bf had some kind of curried tofu which he seemed to enjoy!

They say the third time is the charm, but it was the second that did it for me.  I had a bbq bowl... vegan bbq, slaw, collard greens, and bbq sauce.  It was hearty portion and I had enough for leftovers the next day!  Everything in the bowl was very flavorful. This may be my go-to dish when I come here from now on!

Let's talk about the sweets. They make these "cookie dough" desserts.  The chocolate chip cookie dough one is good....but the oatmeal raisin one is HEAVENLY!  It turned my non-oatmeal raisin liking-boyfriend into a believer! 

Definitely recommend this place. For vegans and vegetarians...but also whoever else, I promise, you won't miss the real meat!  Great portions, great food, for great prices!

Got curbside pickup. The fried chicken was hot and fresh, but it was unseasoned. It tasted like oil and the breading wasn't fully cooked. Some parts had clumps of uncooked flour on the inside. There are many better places for fried chicken in New Orleans.

We stopped for a quick beer while exploring the area...first was very pleased with the fact they check temperature before letting you in. Came to the bar upstairs and it's clean, enforcing social distancing. The bartender, Luke, has great customer service skills; friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable. We had samples of several beers and decided on their Deep Blue Tangerine Wheat, fresh and just citrusy enough. Their Cheese Curds appetizer is the best, made with mozzarella from a local dairy, deliciously soft with a great flavorful marinara sauce for dipping. Nice ambiance. The only reason it's not a 5 it's because we did not order full menu, etc. But, if I'm in the area, I will definitely stop here again.

I found this place from Yelp and I was not disappointed!!!  My mother ordered the grilled shrimp with no seasoning and I ordered the blackened shrimp. Hers had wonderful flavor, despite no seasoning. The portions are huge and well priced. Our food only took about 10 min and it was ready. Highly recommend. We will be back!!

Food was good but service was slow and not all sides were delivered to table. Coffee arrived 25 minutes after desserts. Only deducted one star as food was really good but service definitely left us questioning whether to return.

I would consider this a 'fast food' Asian restaurant. We ordered egg drop soup (would not recommend!), sweet and sour chicken, egg rolls and shrimp pad Thai. I don't think we'll be back. It was just okay and it had the quality of reheated frozen food. We should have made the short drive to our reliable local favorite, the Sunflower Cafe, instead. It was very clean inside, but the food underwhelmed.

I came here with some friends on a Friday afternoon for lunch. We had a few bottles of wine, multiple appetizers, and each a main course. The food was absolutely delicious, just what you would expect from traditional Italian food. I had their tiramisu gelato at the end and it was absolutely delicious. The ambiance is quiet and somewhat romantic too so it looks like it would be a great spot for a date!

We ordered takeout last night. We had never eaten here before, but the menu was quite impressive so we thought we would give it a chance. Wow!  Are we ever glad we did!!!!  The reasonableness of the price, the presentation of the food, the speed of how soon it was ready and the taste were outstanding!  We inhaled all the sushi. So good. We will definitely be back and looking forward to our next visit.

Had breakfast there, eggs Sardu.  It was supposed to have an artichoke bottom, spinach & ham.  They used a plain untoasted piece of white bread instead of an English muffin.  There was no artichoke bottom, just a smear of frozen spinach & some slices of lunch meat ham.  The poached egg was cooked completely hard.  The whole order was almost cold.  This is hard to explain given that there were only 2 tables of 2.  Not a place I would visit again.
My wife and I stopped in for Friday Happy Hour. Really enjoyed the 5 dollar menu especially the steak egg rolls! Very good beer selection, attentive and friendly staff. We'll be back

Start visiting this place shortly after it was opened. Very nice building, fancy revolving door (feel like a kid lost in the elevator). Looking good inside as well. Big windows inside so brewery visible from the dining room. 
Like cleanliness, good set up. Pretty good quality food. On the pricey side tho. 
Great happy hour. Monday special- any pizza 1/2 price for full quality always bring me here. Skipping some weeks just to keep my weight down as much as i can.
Definitely will be back!
Never had a bad meal there. The Cajun Alfredo dish is superb.  Great bacon cheeseburgers, too.

We stopped in for lunch and loved the food. I had the hot chicken with turnip greens and fried green tomatoes. My husband, Robert, had the meatloaf with mashed potatoes and macaroni n cheese. Chocolate Cake finished a delicious meal. Owner Hattie came out to check on us. Nice place we will me back.

Tried again. Over two years since we were last there. Only because we had a dinner card someone had given us. The food was in a word, poor. The hamburger bun my wife had was hard and left out or in the grill until it dried out. Asked for another bun, not any better. I had the brisket tacos. The flour tortillas were grilled and hard, again like they were stale but just over cooked. Should have been left alone probably. The filling was brisket mush. We live in Tucson, not NY city and these were someone's disaster of what they think brisket tacos should be. No hotness at all. No pico, no salsa, not even limes. Just a mushy meat paste and fried onion out of a can on leathery tough tortillas. Who the heck eats food like this? Apparently the locals don't like it much as it was dinner time on a Friday and many of the tables were empty. One lady near us after taking a bite of something she ordered, couldn't make out what it was made the statement that it tasted different. Yes different, like my tacos and my wife's tasteless burger, (maybe try seasoning it and not burning it) much much different than real food. It's sad when we compare this place to what it was years ago when it first opened, you couldn't get a seat without waiting 30-45 minutes, and the food was outstanding. Now it's unrecognizable, tastes funny and apparently drives the customers away. Lots of open tables though, so no waiting.

The food and drink was good.  I ordered the sampler platter. The goi cuon was like everywhere else.  The cha goi is very good.  My toddler ate 2 of them.  The place is clean and the seating was very comfortable.

I didn't come here for the wings, but that's one of the top reasons to go back. 
I had passed this place a few times before, never enticed to go in. I went when a friend and I were turned away from another place because someone had put their car into a power pole and knocked out the electricity. This unfortunate turn caused me to find a new favorite spot for small bits of chicken cooked over a beautiful bed of charcoal instead of being boiled in oil. The result was simple and fantastic. Loved the flavor and texture. Really brilliant. 
I said I didn't come here for the wings, and that was true. Our detour from the previous target had us settling for pizza, and the pizza here turned out to be another reason to return later. Good ingredients, well prepared over coals: excellent pizza in a crowded market. 
But it was the good service that turned us on for the wings. Since we confessed to the server that we had never frequented this place before, she offered to bring us each a couple of wings to try one the house. That turned into a subsequent dozen. 
I was told later by another friend that as food as those were, there's an even better recipe on offer at Anthony's. So yes, I'll be back. 
Great food and service in a relatively quiet and clean establishment. They've earned every star.

Every time I come to Clearwater which is 3-4 times a year, this is my go to spot. Live entertainment on the deck sipping a cold one right on the beach is all that needs to be said. Menu has almost everything to offer as well w decent food.

What a great place. Very accommodating they gave us seating exactly where we asked for. Jessie our host was great! Very attentive and personable. Happy hour and the food top notch. Highly recommend, wish we found this earlier in our trip.

Really interesting flavors! We sat at the bar and enjoyed a few appetizers and an entree on Christmas Eve. The cow heel soup was particularly complex and the curried goat was definitely a highlight. The only minus was that the waitress spilt some of the Caribbean milk punch I ordered and didn't offer to replace it. Since it's Christmas Eve, I wasn't particularly concerned and didn't mention it.

Overall good times and I expect this place to pick up a Michelin star soon.

Been here twice since the new "COVID-19" world took over in March and adore how this place has adapted. They have takeout food and, get this, takeout margaritas! (just take them home first, of course ;) The food has been very good and you should call ahead if possible and give them some time. There is waiting space outside. Ask if they have the "bento" box going- a special deal that includes said margaritas and a TON of food.

This is a great spot to go on a Saturday / Sunday game day.

The food is pretty good for a place I'd classify as a sports bar and the clientele is young and energetic (great spot for millennials in center city).

I took off three stars for the service. At the bar it's been fine, but I find the hostesses/servers to be a little rude and full of attitude. We even had a server make a snarky comment about the beer my friends and I chose to order (it didn't particularly phase us & has become a running joke with us now, however I could see it being a big turn off to a lot of clientele). Also the bar area itself is a little cramped, I'd love to see that widened up to enhance the social vibe!
Green Eggs Cafe is a bit pricey but totally worth the stop!! Their pancakes are incredible! And they have great mimosas.

I have been a big fan of sushi but when I had Ichiban for the 1st time, it was not my last time! 

The sushi is fresh and in good size quantities and good value compared to other competitors. Monday half price was a go to for dinner every week! 

The pineapple rice comes in large quantity as well. You get full fast so bring an empty tummy!

Highly recommend the "Philly Roll"

First time here!

My hubby and I have really been trying to get back on our "date night" game and they some places we've been eyeballing. Tonight we ended up here because it was nearby and did not have a wait.

We were greeted immediately and walked to a table back by the kitchen and what appeared to be a small group room. Our server was Sarah F. and I want to use this space to recognize her for being so awesome. She had a great personality and made my dinner experience top notch by recommending my entree and drink. 

I had the Pasta Ala Vodka for dinner. Man oh man was it delicious. The ravioli was so tender and melted in my mouth. The Vodka sauce was the best I've ever tasted and the pancetta was PERFECTO. I was blessed to wash it all down with the refreshing strawberry fresca drink with pieces of fresh strawberries in it. My hubby had lamb chops which he said he enjoyed but has had better elsewhere. Regardless, Brio had me living my BEST LIFE. I can officially recommend my dish to anyone planning to dine there. Go on my friend, enjoy!
My favorite coffee place even during Covid they service is awesome and the coffee and treats always fresh and yummy
